finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 37 carry user-facing change.

Three breaks, and only one is loud. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from `auth`, `core`, `db`, `jobs`. The v1 export route is gone.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Two things to check before you ship:

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| Node minimum | `.nvmrc` and CI moved to node 22. No `engines` bump in the log. |
| v1 export route | Commit calls it unused. Confirm nobody calls it. |
